summary: Short east kerb beside a house, with no-stopping signs along it.

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 7 m at 12 m, another 15 m; bowling club and apartments nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars park on the opposite side; east side has little verge and trees.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end side street off a main road.
drivers.convention: Cars park in the street, but three No Stopping Any Time signs sit on this kerb.

flags: Slope about 4.6% mean, 14% max over short steps
sun_shade: Trees shade the east side from the east and midday.

best_section.where: Northern end of Carr Street east kerb, past the red-roof house
